item.title: 2012 Jeep Wrangler Sahara 6-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 2012 Jeep Wrangler Sahara is a black-over-black example powered by a 3.6-liter Pentastar V6 linked to a six-speed manual transmission and a dual-range transfer case. Equipment includes a three-piece removable hardtop, 18" five-spoke alloy wheels, four-wheel disc brakes, air conditioning, cruise control, a CD stereo, and an Alpine sound system with a subwoofer. This JK Wrangler has 63k miles and is offered by the selling dealer at no reserve in Florida with an owner's manual, a clean Carfax

item.description: This 2011 Dodge Challenger Drag Pak is #16 of approximately 70 track-only examples produced for the model year. The car is powered by a 8.4-liter V10 paired with a TCI two-speed automatic transmission and is finished in Bright White with a black Mopar Logo body wrap over Viper-sourced bolstered seats upholstered in black leather. item.title: 22k-Mile 1996 GMC Yukon 2-Door SLT 4×4
item.description: This 1996 GMC Yukon SLT is a two-door 4×4 example that is said to have remained registered to the original owner in Delaware and Maryland through 2025 and now shows 22k miles. Finished in Fire Red and Quicksilver Metallic over gray leather, the truck is powered by a 5.7-liter Vortec V8 linked with a four-speed automatic transmission, a dual-range transfer case, and a locking rear differential. item.title: 32-Years-Owned 1988 BMW 635CSi at No Reserve
item.description: This 1988 BMW 635CSi was purchased in 1993 by the current owner and has remained registered in Connecticut since new. Powered by a 3.4-liter M30 inline-six paired with a four-speed automatic transmission, it is finished in Cirrus Blue Metallic over Silver Gray leather upholstery. Equipment includes 390mm bottlecap alloy wheels, power-adjustable front seats, an assette stereo, cruise control, and air conditioning. item.title: 17k-Mile 2015 Mercedes-Benz G63 AMG Performance Studio Package
item.description: This 2015 Mercedes-Benz G63 AMG was purchased new by the seller and is finished in the Performance Studio package’s Alien Green over Designo Black Nappa leather upholstery. Power is provided by a twin-turbocharged 5.5-liter V8 linked with a seven-speed automatic transmission, a dual-range transfer case, and three locking differentials. item.title: 1996 Jaguar XJS 2+2 Convertible
item.description: This 1996 Jaguar XJS 2+2 was repainted in white in 2025 and is powered by a 4.0-liter inline-six linked to a four-speed automatic transmission. It has a black soft top, a rear spoiler, quad headlights, and 16″ five-spoke alloy wheels as well as Charcoal leather seat upholstery. The car was acquired by the seller in 2025 and now shows 47k miles. This XJS is offered in Canada with an owner's manual, a Carfax report, and Ontario registration in the seller’s name.

item.title: 1963 Fiat 500D
item.description: This 1963 Fiat 500D underwent a refurbishment in Italy from 2019 to 2023 that involved a repaint, an interior re-trim, and mechanical work. Chassis 482040 was subsequently acquired by the selling dealer and brought to the US in 2025. The car is finished in blue and features a folding canvas roof panel as well as a luggage rack fitted with a wicker basket.
